You will work with business and technical teams to make enterprise data discoverable, trusted, and well governed. 
 Key Responsibilities Implement and configure Informatica IDMC Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC), Axon, or Enterprise Data Catalog (EDC) for enterprise data governance. Define data governance policies, data ownership, and stewardship models, and set up governance workflows. Build and maintain end-to-end data lineage (business, technical, and column-level) across source systems, ETL pipelines, data warehouses, and BI tools. Configure and run metadata scanners and catalog resources for databases, ETL tools, cloud platforms, and reporting tools. Create and manage the business glossary, data dictionary, critical data elements (CDEs), and data domains. Link business terms to technical assets and stitch lineage across systems, including custom and manual lineage where needed. Perform impact analysis and lineage validation to support change management, audit, and regulatory needs. Define data quality rules, profiling, and scorecards using Informatica Cloud Data Quality (CDQ). Design and develop data integration mappings and taskflows using IDMC Cloud Data Integration (CDI), where required. Write and optimize SQL queries for metadata analysis and data validation. Work with data owners, stewards, architects, and ETL teams to onboard data assets into the catalog. Troubleshoot scanner, lineage, and catalog issues, and tune performance. Create governance documentation, dashboards, and training material, and drive adoption of governance practices. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Experience: 4-7 years in data management, data governance, or data integration, with at least 2 years on Informatica IDMC or related governance tools. Hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC (CDGC, Axon, or EDC) and metadata scanners. Strong understanding of data lineage concepts, including technical, business, and column-level lineage. Good knowledge of data governance frameworks (DAMA-DMBOK), data stewardship, and data policies. Working knowledge of Informatica Data Quality, profiling, and rule creation. Good understanding of data warehousing, ETL, and data modelling concepts. Strong SQL skills for metadata analysis and validation. Excellent stakeholder management, documentation, and communication skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

description:
Time and Venue:

Timing: 10.00 AM - 1.00 PM
Venue: Interview Location-Sodexo GBS
11th Floor, IT4 Building,
NESCO Center, North Wing,
Goregaon East, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400063

1. Purpose of the Job State concisely the aim of the job. This role is the first point of contact for service requests received by the Regional Command Centre. The Helpdesk Team Member captures, validates and logs requests received by phone, email and self-service channels, applies the correct priority and SLA, and ensures complete and accurate work orders are handed over to the Scheduling team, supporting effective and compliant service delivery from India GBS, Mumbai. 2. Dimensions Point out the main figures / indicators to give some insight on the volumes managed by the position and/or the activity of the Department. Characteristics 
 Individual contributor handling inbound and outbound calls, shared mailboxes and self-service request queues, without direct people management responsibility. Creates and validates reactive work orders, escalates emergency requests and supports achievement of telephony, email and SLA / KPI targets. Operates in support of the Regional Command Centre from India GBS, Mumbai. 3. Organization chart Indicate schematically the position of the job within the organization. It is sufficient to indicate one hierarchical level above (including possible functional boss) and, if applicable, one below the position. In the horizontal direction, the other jobs reporting to the same superior should be indicated. 4. Context and main issues Describe the most difficult types of problems the jobholder has to face (internal or external to Sodexo) and/or the regulations, guidelines, practices that are to be adhered to. Capturing complete and accurate requester, location, access and fault information while handling high call and email volumes. Applying contract scope, classification, priority and SLA rules consistently across multiple client contracts. Recognizing emergency requests and following the contract-specific escalation route without delay. Managing incomplete, duplicate or out-of-scope requests while maintaining professional customer experience. Ensuring work orders handed over to the Scheduling team are complete and ready for assignment. Working within a shift-based environment and adhering to SOPs, data quality standards and the knowledge bank. Compliance with Sodexo policies, procedures, health and safety requirements, and ethical standards. 5. Main assignments Indicate the main activities / duties to be conducted in the job. Handle inbound calls using diagnostic scripting to capture caller details, building location, nature of fault and access requirements. Check for duplicates and contract scope, apply the correct classification and priority, and raise reactive work orders in the system. Manage the Helpdesk shared mailbox on an oldest-first basis, raising work orders for each request and filing completed emails. Validate self-service requests for accuracy, completeness, location, classification and priority, and correct them where required. Make outbound calls to requesters to obtain missing information requested by the Scheduling team and update work orders accordingly. Handle calls and emails from suppliers and site engineers (e.g. attendance and job status updates), updating work orders accordingly. Escalate emergencies by phone, notify the named Scheduler and on-site contacts, and follow the contract-specific escalation list. Handle out-of-hours requests in line with the contract service matrix, logging actions clearly for the day team. Log customer complaints and cancellations accurately and pass them to the relevant owner for resolution. Keep knowledge bank information up to date, including site lead and engineer details, as changes occur. Participate in call and email quality reviews, coaching and refresher training, and apply feedback. Identify opportunities for process improvement and communicate recommendations to the Helpdesk Team Lead. Perform all other duties as required. 6. Accountabilities Give the 3 to 5 key outputs of the position vis--vis the organization; they should focus on end results, not duties or activities. Accurate and complete work orders raised within agreed telephony, email and SLA targets. Timely escalation of emergency and high-priority requests through the correct contract route. Clear and complete handovers to the Scheduling team, minimizing rework and outbound follow-ups. Professional and consistent customer interactions that meet quality and compliance standards. Contribution to continuous improvement of Helpdesk processes and knowledge content. 7. Person Specification Indicate the skills, knowledge and experience that the job holder should require to conduct the role effectively Qualification: Graduate, fluent in English. Years of experience: 2-6 years. Experience in a Command Centre, Helpdesk, Contact Centre, BPO, Facilities Management or Customer Service environment. Working knowledge of ERP (e.g., Salesforce, Maximo) is desirable. Understanding reactive maintenance, priorities and SLA / KPI concepts is desirable. Strong call handling and diagnostic questioning skills. Clear and professional telephone manner, comfortable handling calls from based customers and suppliers, with familiarity with English, geography and addresses. Good MS Office skills, including Outlook and Excel. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions under pressure. Flexible and adaptable to change, and willing to incorporate changes to duties, methods and working hours. Ability to work effectively in a rotational shift-based environment aligned to service hours, including nights, weekends and public holidays as rostered. Demonstrates Sodexo values and behaviors. Strong commitment to Zero Harm and a positive safety culture. Successful completion of pre-employment background verification is required; client-specific screening equivalent to BPSS / DBS may apply depending on the accounts supported. 8. Competencies Indicate which of the Sodexo core competencies and any professional competencies that the role requires Growth, Client & Customer Satisfaction / Quality of Services provided Communication Analysis and Decision Making Planning and organising Rigorous Management of Results Learning & Development

title: Commerce & Content Architect
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for the senior technical authority for Adobe Commerce and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutioning in our India practice. You will design and deliver end-to-end content and commerce solutions across the whole Adobe Commerce estate, from legacy Magento to SaaS and headless storefronts. This role has three parts. First, you own presales end to end, from discovery to the oral defence of proposals. Second, you keep an active, billable presence across client engagements. Third, you spearhead Bounteous's agentic commerce offering, taking clients from a "website that sells" to a "commerce platform that agents can transact with." 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Commerce & Content Architecture Lead technical design and build scalable solution architecture for complex B2C, B2B and hybrid commerce programs. Architect across every Adobe Commerce deployment model: Magento Open Source Adobe Commerce on-premises Adobe Commerce on Cloud infrastructure (PaaS) Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service (ACCS, SaaS) Adobe Commerce Optimizer layered over existing or third-party backends Advise clients on the trade-offs in code ownership, hosting, upgrade responsibility, extensibility and licensing. Define modernization and replatforming paths from Magento 1 and Magento 2 Enterprise/Open Source estates. This includes moving in-process PHP customizations to out-of-process extensibility with Adobe App Builder, Adobe I/O Events, webhooks and API Mesh. Define reference architectures for composable and headless commerce: Commerce Storefront powered by Edge Delivery Services Commerce drop-in components (B2C and B2B) Catalog Service, Live Search and Product Recommendations GraphQL and REST integration patterns PWA Studio and custom React/Next.js frontends where appropriate Architect content + commerce with AEM in both modes: Traditional / hybrid: AEM Sites with the Commerce Integration Framework (CIF), including running Edge Delivery and CIF pages side by side during phased migrations. Headless / modern: AEM as a Cloud Service with Content Fragments and GraphQL, Edge Delivery Services, Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring, and Product Visuals powered by AEM Assets. Design integrations with ERP, OMS, PIM, payments, tax, search, 3PL, CRM and identity systems. Validate the client's roadmap against current and expected Adobe Commerce features. Own non-functional architecture: performance and caching (Varnish, Fastly/CDN, Redis/Valkey), search (OpenSearch), message queues (RabbitMQ/AMQP), high availability, security, PCI and data-privacy compliance across regions. 
 Presales & Solutioning Lead consultative discovery and solution-definition workshops with client business and technology stakeholders. Translate business requirements into solution blueprints, integration diagrams, technical narratives and delivery plans. Build bottom-up effort estimates, assumptions, risks and dependencies, and phased roadmaps. Partner with Growth, Delivery and Client Partner teams on commercial models. Prepare compelling proposals and Statements of Work with the technical solution design, engagement and execution approach, timelines and estimates. Present and defend them orally to client executives and procurement panels. Build and run demos, proofs of concept and capability showcases, including agentic commerce prototypes. 
 Agentic Commerce Innovation Define Bounteous's agentic commerce reference architecture for Adobe clients. Make catalog, pricing, inventory, cart, checkout, order and post-purchase capabilities safely accessible to AI agents through the Adobe Commerce MCP Server, App Builder and API Mesh. Design solutions with Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker, Adobe Experience Platform Agent Orchestrator, Experience Platform Agents and Brand Concierge for conversational, grounded shopping experiences. Assess client readiness for AI discovery surfaces (including product feeds) and architect support for open agentic-commerce standards: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), from Google and major retailers Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), from OpenAI and Stripe Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) Design and build custom MCP servers, agents and skills with Anthropic's Claude (Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, Agent Skills). Example use cases include B2B buying and reordering assistants, merchandising and catalog-enrichment agents, order-management and customer-service agents, and AI-assisted migration and code-modernization agents. Build guardrails into every agentic design: authentication and delegated authorization, spend limits, human-in-the-loop approval, fraud and agent-trust controls, auditability, observability and evaluation. Use the Adobe Commerce Developer Agent, the App Builder MCP and Claude Code to accelerate delivery, and set standards for AI-assisted code review, testing and security scanning. Turn innovations into reusable Bounteous accelerators, demos and intellectual property. 
 Delivery Leadership & Governance Provide architectural guidance to engineers through build, QA and deployment, reviewing implementation against architectural intent. Assess client environments, analyze project issues and act as the escalation point and decision-maker on critical technical issues across concurrent engagements. Establish coding standards, review mechanisms, DevOps/CI-CD practices (Cloud Manager, ECE-Tools, GitHub/GitLab) and delivery governance aligned with Adobe best practices. 
 Practice Building & Mentoring Mentor architects and senior engineers and share technical knowledge across the Adobe DX and Commerce practice. Contribute to the India practice's competency roadmap, Centre of Excellence, internal trainings, hackathons and certification programs, including Adobe and Claude certifications. Represent Bounteous in Adobe and Anthropic partner forums, client briefings and industry events. Contribute thought leadership on agentic commerce. 
 Required Qualifications Experience in commerce architecture, digital platforms or enterprise application design, including 5+ years in a Lead or Technical Architect capacity on Magento / Adobe Commerce. Extensive hands-on architecture experience across legacy Magento versions: Magento 1 (Community and Enterprise Edition) and Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce (Open Source and Commerce/Enterprise), including M1M2 and M2Cloud migrations. Deep knowledge of Adobe Commerce on Cloud infrastructure: environments, deployment, scaling, Fastly, New Relic and tuning. Working knowledge of Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service and Adobe Commerce Optimizer. Proven experience designing headless and composable Adobe Commerce architectures. Hands-on experience integrating Adobe Commerce with AEM, in both CIF-based and headless modes. Strong experience integrating commerce platforms with enterprise systems for both B2B and B2C. Technical proficiency in PHP, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, MySQL, Redis, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ and CDN/edge configuration. Demonstrated end-to-end presales track record with senior client stakeholders. Working understanding of agentic AI architectures (LLMs, tool calling, RAG, multi-agent orchestration) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications Adobe Certified Master Adobe Commerce Architect (AD0-E722), plus Adobe Commerce Developer Expert certifications. Adobe Certified Master AEM Sites Architect (AD0-E117) or AEM Sites Developer Expert. Hands-on experience building with Claude / Anthropic: agents, skills and custom MCP servers. Claude is our preferred model platform. Prototype or production experience with Adobe's agentic tools (including AEM Co-worker and Adobe LLM Optimizer), UCP/ACP/AP2 or commerce MCP implementations. Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform / Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Analytics/CJA and Adobe Target as they relate to commerce personalization. Exposure to other commerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, commercetools, Shopify Plus) for competitive and replatforming conversations. Experience in a consultancy or agency environment serving global clients across time zones. 
 Soft Skills Executive presence and a consultative, trusted-advisor style. You can explain complex architecture to non-technical stakeholders. Strong written communication. A commercial mindset that balances scope, risk, margin and client value. Curiosity and a bias to build. You prototype new technology quickly. A collaborative leadership style across onshore and offshore teams. Ownership and accountability in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

You will join one of our international engineering squads (Germany and India), working under the guidance of your Software Engineering Team Lead and senior engineers on your team. You will be given real, well-scoped pieces of work - not busywork - and the support to grow quickly: pairing, code review, and structured feedback are part of how the team operates day to day. This is a strong platform to learn on. Our codebase is large and touches many interconnected components, so youll build not just coding skill but the habit of thinking carefully about how a change affects the wider system - a skill that compounds over your whole career. Responsibilities Feature Implementation: Implement well-scoped features, bug fixes, and enhancements under the guidance of your Team Lead and senior engineers. Write clean, tested code across the stack - C#/.NET services, SQL Server data access, and React front-ends - following established patterns and standards. Break down assigned tasks into clear implementation steps, asking clarifying questions early rather than guessing at ambiguous requirements. Fix defects identified by QA or reported in production, learning to diagnose root causes rather than just patching symptoms. Quality & Testing: Write unit and integration tests for the code you deliver, as a core part of "done" rather than an optional extra. Participate in code reviews - both receiving feedback and, as you grow, reviewing the work of peers. Follow the team's engineering standards: layered architecture, API design conventions, and our React corporate design system. Verify your own changes thoroughly before raising them for review, including checking for obvious edge cases. Learning & Growth: Actively build your understanding of the platform's architecture, data model, and key components - asking questions and using documentation, pairing, and code reading to ramp up. Seek and act on feedback from code reviews, 1:1s, and pairing sessions - treating early mistakes as part of the learning process. Build foundational skills in requirements analysis, technical design, and estimation by working alongside more senior engineers on real tasks. Collaboration: Work closely with your Team Lead, senior engineers, QA, and Business Analysts as part of daily squad activities (stand-ups, planning, reviews). Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly and early - this is more valuable at this stage than trying to solve everything independently. Contribute positively to an international team culture, working comfortably with colleagues across time zones. AI-Augmented Engineering: Use AI tools in your day-to-day work - for learning, coding assistance, debugging, and documentation - under guidance from senior engineers, building good habits for using them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. title: Analytics Engineer-Senior AI / RAG Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description Experience Level: 5+ Years
Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote Flexible
 Executive Overview
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior AI & RAG Platform Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering and applied AI experience to lead the architecture, configuration, optimisation, and production deployment of our generative AI capabilities. In this role, you will be the technical owner responsible for designing advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing vector indexing and retrieval lifecycle, orchestrating foundation models (both open-source and proprietary), and embedding these AI services natively into our in-house custom-developed platform.
 Key Responsibilities
1. Advanced RAG Architecture & Pipeline Configuration
• End-to-End Retrieval Pipelines: Design, configure, and optimise enterprise RAG pipelines combining dense vector search, sparse keyword search (BM25), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and cross-encoder reranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE).
• Document Parsing & ETL: Build robust ingestion workflows for parsing, segmenting, and embedding multi-format documents (PDFs, Markdown, relational data, APIs) with semantic chunking and hierarchy preservation.
• Vector Lifecycle & Operations: Configure and maintain production vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), including multi-tenant partitioning, payload indexing, and HNSW index tuning.
2. AI Model Selection, Orchestration & Agents
• Model Integration: Evaluate, select, and configure foundation models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Llama 3.1/3.3, Mistral) based on cost, context limits, latency, and task complexity.
• Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling: Implement structured schema decoding (JSON/Pydantic), function calling, and multi-step agentic execution flows (using LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom workflows).
• Fine-Tuning & Serving (Optional/Targeted): Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA) when necessary, and deploy open-weight models via inference servers such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama.
3. Custom Platform Integration & Engineering
• API & Microservice Development: Design and expose scalable REST, gRPC, and WebSocket streaming endpoints using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) to interface between LLM workflows and our proprietary platform microservices.
• State & Memory Management: Build sliding-window conversational memory, persistent session tracking, semantic caching (Redis / GPTCache), and tenant-level access control at the retrieval boundary.
• Async & Event-Driven Processing: Integrate heavy inference and document embedding pipelines into distributed message brokers and queues (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).
4. LLMOps, Guardrails & Quality Assurance
• Quantitative Evaluation: Establish continuous RAG evaluation frameworks (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) tracking Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Precision, and Hallucination rates.
• Guardrails & Security: Implement strict guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), prompt-injection mitigation, PII masking, and data privacy governance.
• Observability: Track latency, token utilization, rate limits, and end-to-end trace flows using Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry.
Candidate Requirements & Qualifications
Must-Have Requirements
• 5+ years of professional backend/software engineering experience, with primary expertise in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, multiprocessing).
• 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating RAG pipelines and production LLM-based solutions.
• Deep practical knowledge of AI orchestration frameworks: LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, or custom agent engines.
• Production experience with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
• Strong background in microservices architecture, RESTful/gRPC design, WebSocket streaming for token generation, and distributed caching (Redis).
• Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and query performance tuning.
• Proficient in Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and major cloud ecosystems (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect – AI & Agentic Platforms to lead the architecture and development of the Agentic AI Runtime Layer for a large-scale Enterprise Platform. This is a hands-on architecture and technology leadership role requiring deep expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, distributed systems and enterprise platform engineering. You will build the reusable runtime that enables enterprise agents to understand business intent, plan and execute tasks, maintain context and state, invoke tools and APIs, and collaborate with specialized agents. You will also lead the architecture and engineering of an embedded intelligent enterprise agent that uses this runtime to coordinate platform capabilities and support users from insight through decision and authorized action. 
 Key Responsibilities Own the target architecture and engineering roadmap for the Agentic AI Runtime Layer and the embedded intelligent enterprise agent. Design scalable single-agent and multi-agent orchestration, including task decomposition, routing, planner and executor patterns, and agent collaboration. Build reusable services for agent registration, configuration, discovery, execution, versioning and lifecycle management. Define conversation, session, user and business context management, persistent memory, workflow state, context retrieval and token optimization. Design tool registries, tool discovery, function calling and permission-aware execution across enterprise APIs, microservices, data platforms and external systems. Establish a model abstraction layer supporting multiple providers, model routing, fallback, prompt versioning and structured outputs. Define Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding and enterprise knowledge retrieval patterns with appropriate data access controls. Architect interactive, background, asynchronous and long-running workflows with human approval checkpoints and controlled execution. Build security and governance into the runtime, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, prompt injection protection, sensitive data controls and audit trails. Establish observability for workflow execution, model calls, tool invocation, latency, failures, token usage and operating cost. Build evaluation and regression frameworks for task completion, groundedness, tool-selection accuracy, recommendation quality and business-rule compliance. Develop reusable APIs, SDKs, reference implementations and agent development patterns for engineering teams. Evaluate agent frameworks, models and interoperability protocols; make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Lead architecture and code reviews, prototype critical components and mentor engineers across platform and agent development. BizzFree AI helps small and medium-sized businesses transform their operations through artificial intelligence, intelligent automation and digital solutions.

We work with businesses across the UK and US and are expanding our technical team in India.
 About the Role 
We are looking for an experienced and technically skilled AI Automation Engineer who can independently design, develop, integrate, test and deploy AI-powered automation systems for our international clients.
The ideal candidate must have a strong technical background, preferably a B.Tech or B.E. qualification, along with practical experience in AI development, workflow automation, API integrations and software engineering.
You will be responsible for converting business requirements into functional, reliable and scalable AI automation solutions.
This is a hands-on engineering role. We are looking for someone who can build complete automation systems rather than someone with only theoretical knowledge of AI tools.

 Design, develop and deploy AI-powered automation workflows for businesses. Build complex workflow automations using n8n, Make and Zapier. Develop AI agents using OpenAI, Claude and other large language models (LLMs). Build intelligent AI chatbots and customer support automation systems. Develop AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer calls. Integrate AI systems with CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot and Salesforce. Required Technical Skills

Experience developing AI agents and intelligent conversational systems. Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI model integrations. Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is preferred. 2. Workflow Automation 
 Hands-on experience with n8n is highly preferred. Experience with Make (Integromat) or Zapier. Ability to build complex multi-step automation workflows. Strong understanding of workflow logic, triggers, conditions, loops and error handling. 3. Programming & Development 
 Strong knowledge of Python and/or JavaScript. Understanding of backend development and software architecture. Experience working with JSON, databases and SQL. Ability to write custom scripts and develop API integrations. Strong debugging and problem-solving capabilities. 4. API & System Integrations 
 Strong understanding of REST APIs and webhooks. Experience with API authentication, OAuth and third-party integrations. Ability to connect multiple software applications and platforms. Experience integrating CRM systems, communication platforms and business applications. 5. Cloud & Deployment 
 Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud or Azure. Experience with hosting, deployment and server management. Understanding of Docker and basic DevOps practices is an advantage. Familiarity with database management and cloud infrastructure. Additional Advantageous Skills

Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple business language. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Self-motivated, organised and capable of working independently. Comfortable working in a remote, international team environment. Strong ownership, accountability and attention to detail. What We Offer

description:
About Us E2M is not your regular digital marketing firm. Were an equal opportunity provider, founded on strong business ethics and driven by more than 300 experienced professionals. Our client base is made of digital agencies that need help with solving their bandwidth problems, cutting overheads, and increasing profitability. We need diligent professionals like you to help us help them. If youre someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you. 1. Program Overview Title: AI Engineer Internship: Full-Stack AI, LLM APIs & Applied Development Duration: 6 months Location: On-Site (Ahmedabad) Type: Paid Internship Objective: Provide students with real-world experience building practical AI products, using LLM APIs, frontend, backend, databases, and automation logic, with mentorship and an opportunity to join our team full-time upon successful completion. About the Internship: As an AI Engineer Intern, youll work with our AI team to design and ship real working solutions: AI-powered micro apps, internal tools, dashboards, and client-facing AI products. This role is not about only using ChatGPT or writing prompts. Youll learn to build end-to-end solutions using AI APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), frontend and backend frameworks, databases, and AI-assisted development tools. This internship is best suited for candidates who want to become AI Engineers, not just AI users, solving real business problems for digital agencies. 2. Selection Criteria Education Background: Currently pursuing a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields. Fundamental coursework in programming, software development, or applied AI (at least one foundational course completed or in progress). Technical Skills: Programming: Basic working knowledge of Python. Backend: Basic understanding of APIs and backend development (REST APIs, server logic). Frontend: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend development. Databases: Understanding of databases and CRUD operations. AI/LLM APIs: Interest in integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar) into applications. AI Tooling: Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, etc.) to build faster. Soft Skills & Mindset: Ownership mindset, not just a task-completion mindset, with eagerness to build quickly. Clear communicator who can document work and ask the right questions when blocked. Collaboration: Ability to work in fast-moving teams and follow project guidelines. Problem-Solving: Ability to search, learn, debug, and implement independently. Bonus Skills (Not Mandatory, but Nice to Have): Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Node.js. Experience with React, Next.js, Streamlit, or similar frontend tools. Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents. Knowledge of Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL, or similar databases. Basic Git / GitHub knowledge and understanding of prompt engineering or structured AI outputs. Any prior project experience, even a university capstone, chatbot, dashboard, or personal AI app. 3. What Youll Work On Build AI-powered micro apps for internal teams and clients. Create custom dashboards and internal productivity tools. Develop AI-native applications using LLM APIs. Work on document automation, proposal generation, report generation, resume/JD matching, and meeting summary tools. Assist in building AI agents, RAG flows, vector search, and document-based AI assistants. Build simple full-stack AI applications across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and AI models. Convert business requirements into working prototypes and MVPs quickly using modern AI tools. Test AI outputs, debug flows, and improve accuracy, formatting, and edge-case handling. 4. What Youll Gain Real-World AI Product Experience: Real-world experience shipping AI products and applications end-to-end. Exposure to frontend, backend, database, and AI model layers used in production environments. Hands-on use of current AI tools and frameworks in live client projects. Mentorship from Experts: Mentorship from senior AI consultants and engineers. Interns will be guided by our experienced AI team that regularly works with digital agencies. Regular check-ins, one-on-one sessions, and skill-building workshops. Practical Exposure to Digital Agency Projects: See how AI is applied in digital marketing, content workflows, client tooling, analytics, and automation. Learn how AI solutions are scoped, built, and integrated for clients across diverse industries. Excellent for anyone aiming to become an AI Engineer within a marketing or consulting environment. Career Development & Opportunities: Internship certificate plus priority consideration for full-time roles in the AI division. Outstanding interns may be offered a full-time position at the end of the internship. Networking opportunities with leaders in AI consulting, digital marketing, and tech. Workshops on resume building, interview preparation, and career growth within the tech sector. 5. Internship Structure & Responsibilities Orientation & Training (Week 1 - 2): Overview of E2M Solutions AI practice and product-building approach. Tool and framework introduction (Python, FastAPI, React / Next.js / Streamlit, Supabase, LLM APIs, AI coding tools). Best practices in project management, documentation, and shipping working prototypes. Hands-On Projects (Weeks 3 to 23): Interns are assigned to real product builds under the guidance of a project lead or mentor. Tasks may include: Building full-stack AI micro apps, dashboards, and internal tools. Integrating LLM APIs into business applications. Writing backend logic and REST APIs for data processing and AI flows. Building RAG-based assistants and document automation tools. Testing, debugging, and creating documentation and user guides. Progress Reviews (Ongoing): Weekly check-ins with mentors and monthly performance evaluations to ensure continuous learning and alignment with project goals. Regular feedback sessions on product builds and code reviews. Final Presentation & Assessment (Last Week): Interns present the AI products and solutions they helped build. Showcase both technical implementation and business impact. Feedback and assessment sessions determine potential offers for full-time roles.
